mechanisms.name: Grow and harvest turnip
steps: Sow one seed in a prepared ploughed plot.
Keep the crop alive until harvest-ready, then harvest with a suitable sharp tool.
Keep spores/seeds for another planting; eat the produce or store it off the floor.
mechanisms.conditions: temperate, sea, tundra or taiga outdoor/open-sky ploughed soil; all four ordinary seasons including winter. Each harvest retires the crop and returns two seeds/spores plus one to three food items depending on fertility; each food has two nutriment. Snowstorm protection does not remove water/soil costs, drought or sandstorm death. Normal stage progression.
mechanisms.map_notes: Rock must be cleared then suitable dirt ploughed. Jungle dirt and Desert-map dust remain unsuitable.
mechanisms.era: Plough: four wood planks, Basic Agriculture research rules (node tier 1); no new era gate for seed or food.
